problem: The canonical Powerhouse System Map drifted behind the actual repository skill topology: 14 skill directories existed while the machine map listed 12 and the provider snapshot reported 11.
root_cause: The repository already required same-lineage System Map registration and human documentation, but snapshot-count parity and explicit human-documentation assertions were not enforced strongly enough in the System Map regression itself.
fix: Reconcile the canonical skill inventory and provider snapshot, make System Map plus human documentation an explicit universal closure rule in AGENTS.md and powerhouse-continuity, and extend regression coverage so snapshot counts and human-documentation obligations fail closed.
prevention: Any structural skill, agent, workflow, function, intelligence-layer or authority change updates the canonical System Map in the same lineage.
Repository human documentation is updated in the same lineage as the structural change.
Provider snapshot counts must equal canonical repository inventory lengths.
SYSTEM_MAP_WRITEBACK_INCOMPLETE and WRITEBACK_INCOMPLETE are non-terminal states.
